payload.claim: The note on the prose gate says it "counts every new comment and docstring," which undersells its scope: .saffron/gates/prose.py's ROOT_FILES tuple includes CLAUDE.md and README.md by name, so the same house-style rule (no em dash, no semicolon, no contraction, no perfect tense, no sentence over 25 words) binds the new prose added to those two files in this spec's own touches, not only new Python comments and docstrings. This doesn't make anything in the spec false, but a cell author reading only "comment and docstring" could reasonably skip applying that same care to the CLAUDE.md/README.md additions and trip the gate.
